puzzle.body: This test is flaky on macOS in GitHub Actions. If the 'lifetime' is less than 15 seconds, the second cycle doesn't start due to insufficient time. If it's more than 15 seconds, the bar judge gets skipped in the second cycle (no time left). To enable this test for macOS, we need to devise a different way to trigger an exception during judge processing.
puzzle.author: @yegor256
